sources.title: OME-Zarr specification 0.5
sources.pin: OME-NGFF 0.5; report dated 2026-10-01; repository revision d9164040dd61b3e4688494de1a58a69251b13f24 (revision in captured document metadata)
sources.locator: Storage format; §§2.1 axes, 2.3 coordinateTransformations, 2.4 multiscales, 2.5 omero, 2.6 labels
sources.applicability: Independent format specification for named axes, units, per-resolution coordinates, display-channel metadata and integer label images. Its multiscale transforms are limited to scale and translation; the proposed internal affine extension must not be exported as NGFF 0.5 without a representable mapping or explicit resampling.

sources.title: napari documentation — Image layer
sources.pin: napari/docs main, captured 2026-10-05; captured body hash is the content pin
sources.locator: Image data and NumPy-like arrays; Multiscale images; Loading multichannel images; Adjusting contrast limits
sources.applicability: Viewer precedent for lazy array access, multiscale display, per-channel layers and separation of contrast visualization from image values. Documentation is not a performance guarantee for this application or its TIFF adapter.

sources.title: napari documentation — Scale and unit-aware rendering
sources.pin: napari/docs main, captured 2026-10-05; captured body hash is the content pin
sources.locator: Scale and units live on layers; When units are consistent across layers; What units do not do
sources.applicability: Viewer precedent for per-layer scale/translation and units in world coordinates, and for keeping axis labels distinct from units.

sources.title: napari documentation — Shapes layer
sources.pin: napari/docs main, captured 2026-10-05; captured body hash is the content pin
sources.locator: Shapes data and controls; copying and pasting shapes; 3D rendering; non-editable mode
sources.applicability: Viewer precedent for nD vertex shapes and per-shape style. The captured documentation says shapes are not editable in 3D rendering; the proposal limits volume-mask editing to 2D slices and does not rely on native 3D shape editing.

sources.title: tifffile README — Read and write TIFF files
sources.pin: README states tifffile 2026.9.20; master is moving, captured body hash pins this document snapshot
sources.locator: Intro format and array-access description; Requirements; Notes on BigTIFF, ImageJ hyperstacks, OME-TIFF and unsupported/quirky cases; Examples for memory mapping, Zarr access and segment reads
sources.applicability: Independent reader implementation precedent: reads array regions from TIFF strips, tiles, pages, SubIFDs and pyramidal levels as NumPy or Zarr arrays. Decoder availability depends on pinned dependencies such as imagecodecs; listed format support does not establish the proposed application’s support.
